answer.text: Start-ups or 'early stage' businesses with high growth potential

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 1.2.1, VC invests in start-ups/early-stage businesses with high growth potential. The Trap: Other options don't match VC profile. Cross-Exam Context: Same as Cat I AIF category in XIX-A. Distributor's Pro-Tip: For VC exposure, recommend Cat I AIF; Cat III AIFs are for more trading-oriented strategies.
